gameVersionCovered: Version 3.0.7 (2026-09-28); status-effect base factors as of the 2025-06-19 balance patch; Reload Efficiency per 2025-05-21 Combat Balance Adjustments (v1.6.1); Weapon/Status Vulnerability split per 2025-12-23 combat-Deviation upgrade (dev blog 2026-02-12)

keyClaims.claim: Psi-based status procs are computed as Psi Intensity x base factor x (1 + <Keyword> DMG Factor Bonus) x (1 + <Keyword> Final DMG Bonus); base factors: Burn 12% per 0.5 s for 6 s, Frost Vortex 50% per 0.5 s for 4 s (one vortex at a time, 4.5 m), Power Surge 50% (Shock state 2 s), Unstable Bomber 120% (1.5 m, radius decay to >=50%).
keyClaims.evidence: Fandom/Steam guide: 'Burn deals 12% PSI Intensity as Status DMG every 0.5s for 6s ... 12% x PSI Intensity x (1 + Burn DMG Factor Bonus) x (1 + Burn Final DMG Bonus)'; 'inflicts 50% PSI intensity status damage every 0.5s for 4s'; 'AoE Shock damage equal to 50% of Psi Intensity'; 'blast of 120% PSI Intensity after 0.1s with a blast radius of 1.5m ... down to a minimum of 50%'; official June-2025 patch 'Unstable Bomber: Damage increased from 100% to 120%'.

keyClaims.claim: Status DMG % and Elemental DMG % (Blaze/Frost/Blast/Shock) are two separate multiplicative factors on status procs (not one additive bucket).
keyClaims.evidence: Sportskeeda worked example: Psi 800 -> Power Surge 400; 'Status Damage 20% and Shock Elemental Damage 6%: 400 x (1 + 20/100) x (1 + 6/100) = 508.8'; GameLeap: 'both Status and Elemental Damage multipliers ... are multiplicative'.

keyClaims.claim: Psi status procs (Burn, Frost Vortex, Power Surge, Unstable Bomber) cannot crit, cannot hit weakspots and ignore range falloff; bullet keywords Shrapnel (60% of Attack) and Bounce (40% of Attack) are Weapon DMG that CAN crit, CAN weakspot and DO fall off, and are not scaled by Status DMG or Psi.
keyClaims.evidence: 'Power Surge ignores critical hits, weak spots, and distance reduction'; Unstable Bomber 'cannot cause crit damage, cannot strike enemy weakspots'; Shrapnel 'deals +60% Attack as Weapon DMG ... can cause crit damage, hit weakspots, and will decay with distance'; dev blog 'Each bounce deals Weapon DMG equal to 40% of your Attack'; GameRant 'Status and Elemental DMG does not affect bullet effects like Bounce, Shrapnel, and Fast Gunner, as they scale off Weapon DMG'. Exceptions: Gilded Gauntlets let Burn crit; Pyroclasm Starter/Pathfinder/Additional Rules charged shots are Status DMG that keep Crit and Weakspot (Feb 2026).

keyClaims.claim: Reload time formula is official: FinalReloadTime = BaseReloadTime / (1 + ReloadEfficiency%); legacy Reload Speed +10 (flat) -> Reload Efficiency +8% and Reload Speed +10% -> +3% (maximum ratios, weapon-type dependent).
keyClaims.evidence: Combat Balance Adjustments 2025-05-21: 'Final Reloading Time = Base Reloading Time / (1 + Reload Efficiency Bonus)'; example 3.634 s with +15% -> 3.16 s (3.634/1.15 = 3.160).

keyClaims.claim: Vulnerability is a target-side multiplier split (since 2025-12-23) into Weapon Vulnerability (affects Weapon DMG) and Status Vulnerability (affects Status DMG); The Bull's Eye = +8% for 12 s, Vulnerability Amplifier adds +8%, Whalepup = 40% Status Vulnerability for 5 s.
keyClaims.evidence: Dev blog 2026-02-12: 'vulnerability types of combat Deviations were standardized into Weapon Vulnerability and Status Vulnerability'; fandom: 'increasing their Vulnerability by 8%, lasting 12 seconds'; 'The Bull's Eye adds Vulnerability +8%'; 'Whalepup applies 40% Status Vulnerability to the target for 5 seconds from each hit'.

keyClaims.claim: Direct-hit damage is a product of additive buckets: Attack x (1+Weapon DMG%) x (1+Crit DMG% if crit) x (1+Weakspot DMG% if weakspot) x (1+DMG vs type%) x (1+Vulnerability%) x (1+All DMG%) x falloff; the weapon card's own Crit DMG / Weakspot DMG stats are part of those sums.
keyClaims.evidence: Community calculators converge on this: OH-Calculator sums within 8 categories (Weapon, Weakspot, Crit, Elemental, Status, Element Final, All Damage Bonus, Debuff) and computes base x Prod(1+factor); getzity: base*(1+weaponDmg)*(1+enemyBonus)*(1+vulnerability)*(1+critDamage); KremaOps: adjustedBase=base*(1+weaponPct). Weapon cards show 'Crit DMG +26.0%, Weakspot DMG +95.0%' (AWS.338) that calculators feed directly.

keyClaims.claim: Crit and Weakspot bonuses on the same hit are DISPUTED: OH-Calculator multiplies (1+crit)(1+weakspot); KremaOps adds (1+crit+weakspot). Recommended default: multiplicative, exposed as a toggle.
keyClaims.evidence: KremaOps index.html: 'critHit = adjustedBase * (1 + effectiveCritDmg + totalWeakspotMult)'; OH-Calculator Sidebar.tsx: 'totalMultiplier = factors.reduce((acc, f) => acc * (1 + val), 1)' with factors Weapon DMG 1.43 / Weakspot 1.59 / Crit 1.70. No in-game test found.

keyClaims.claim: Range falloff: full damage up to the Range stat, then linear-ish decay to a minimum; AWM example 59 m full damage, 107 m minimum-damage range, 10% minimum damage. Status procs ignore it.
keyClaims.evidence: GameRant: 'Range ... how far you can hit an enemy and still do full damage ... your damage will start to taper off'; oncehumandb AWM: 'full damage range of 59m and a minimum damage range of 107m with 10% minimum damage'; 'Burn ticks and Surge procs will always deal full damage regardless of how far away you are'.

keyClaims.claim: Fast Gunner: each stack Fire Rate +1% and Attack +1% for 2 s, max 5 stacks (Blitzkrieg V: +5 stacks and +1% Fire Rate per stack); Predator 40% trigger chance.
keyClaims.evidence: Fandom: 'each stack grants Fire Rate +1% and Attack +1% for 2s. The effect can stack up to 5 times'; Game8 mod list via bramsey679 data: 'Fast Gunner stacks +5 and additional Fire Rate +1% for each stack'; official June-2025: 'triggers Fast Gunner on hit (40% chance)'.

keyClaims.claim: Deviation and other Psi-scaled damage follow the same Psi x factor model; v3.0.7 raised Voodoo Doll's ultimate from '200% Psi Intensity + 10' to '250% Psi Intensity', and Psychic Kid was changed from 'Psi Intensity +5%' to 'Status DMG +5%' (devs treat Psi% and Status DMG% as distinct buckets).
keyClaims.evidence: Official v3.0.7 (2026-09-28) patch note quotes as given.
